details:
Openscap is an open source framework that integrates secure content automation protocols. Its goal is to provide a simple and easy to use interface for using scap.

Security Fix(es):

A flaw was found in OpenSCAP. When decomposing a Source DataStream (SDS) file, the application does not properly validate relative file path attributes, leading to a path traversal vulnerability. An attacker can exploit this flaw by tricking a user or automated system into decomposing a crafted datastream containing directory traversal sequences. Successful exploitation allows unauthorized file creation or modification outside the intended target directory with the permissions of the executing process.(CVE-2026-85518)
